description: Compare ftm3 (146 aa) with the long PF09437 member Q9P3E6 (344 aa): hydropathy and AlphaFold pLDDT profiles
code:
import numpy as np, requests, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def kdwin(seq,w=19):
    h=np.array([KD[c] for c in seq]); n=len(seq); out=np.full(n,np.nan)
    for i in range(n-w+1): out[i+w//2]=h[i:i+w].mean()
    return out

S={}
for a in ["P0CU06","Q9P3E6"]:
    S[a]=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]

# pLDDT for both AlphaFold models
PL={}
for a in ["P0CU06","Q9P3E6"]:
    pdb=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{a}-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text
    b=[float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"]
    PL[a]=np.array(b)
    print(a,"n=%d meanpLDDT %.1f  frac>70 %.2f  frac>90 %.2f"%(len(b),PL[a].mean(),(PL[a]>70).mean(),(PL[a]>90).mean()))

TM={"P0CU06":[(38,60)],
    "Q9P3E6":[(99,119),(121,141),(170,192),(199,219),(223,243),(274,294)]}

# positive-inside statistics for ftm3 single-TM model
s=S["P0CU06"]
n_fl=s[:37]; c_fl=s[60:]
def kr(x): return sum(c in "KR" for c in x)
def de(x): return sum(c in "DE" for c in x)
print("\nftm3 positive-inside check around TM 38-60")
print(f"  N-flank 1-37   len{len(n_fl):3}  K+R={kr(n_fl)}  D+E={de(n_fl)}  net={kr(n_fl)-de(n_fl)}  K+R/100aa={100*kr(n_fl)/len(n_fl):.1f}")
print(f"  C-flank 61-146 len{len(c_fl):3}  K+R={kr(c_fl)}  D+E={de(c_fl)}  net={kr(c_fl)-de(c_fl)}  K+R/100aa={100*kr(c_fl)/len(c_fl):.1f}")
for w in (15,30):
    print(f"  near-flank +/-{w}: N {s[max(0,37-w):37]} K+R={kr(s[max(0,37-w):37])} | C {s[60:60+w]} K+R={kr(s[60:60+w])}")
print("  residues inside TM 38-60:", s[37:60], " K/R inside:", [i+38 for i,c in enumerate(s[37:60]) if c in "KR"])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,7),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,1]})
for col,a in enumerate(["P0CU06","Q9P3E6"]):
    kd=kdwin(S[a]); x=np.arange(1,len(S[a])+1)
    ax=axes[0,col]
    ax.plot(x,kd,color="#1f4e79",lw=1.6)
    ax.axhline(1.6,color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1,label="TM threshold 1.6")
    ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.6)
    for (p,q) in TM[a]: ax.axvspan(p,q,color="#f0a202",alpha=0.35)
    ax.set_ylim(-3.2,2.6); ax.set_xlim(1,len(S[a]))
    ttl = "ftm3 / P0CU06 (146 aa, UPF0742)" if a=="P0CU06" else "SPAC750.05c / Q9P3E6 (344 aa, long PF09437 member)"
    ax.set_title(ttl,fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle, w=19")
    if col==0: ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
    ax2=axes[1,col]
    ax2.plot(np.arange(1,len(PL[a])+1),PL[a],color="#2e7d32",lw=1.4)
    ax2.axhline(70,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1); ax2.axhline(90,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1)
    for (p,q) in TM[a]: ax2.axvspan(p,q,color="#f0a202",alpha=0.35)
    ax2.set_ylim(0,100); ax2.set_xlim(1,len(S[a]))
    ax2.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax2.set_xlabel("residue")
    ax2.text(0.02,0.9,"mean %.1f"%PL[a].mean(),transform=ax2.transAxes,fontsize=9)
axes[0,0].text(0.02,0.9,"1 window above threshold (max 1.61)",transform=axes[0,0].transAxes,fontsize=8,color="#c0392b")
axes[0,1].text(0.02,0.9,"4 window blocks above threshold, 6 annotated TM",transform=axes[0,1].transAxes,fontsize=8,color="#c0392b")
fig.suptitle("ftm3 has one marginal hydrophobic segment; the long PF09437 members carry the 5-6 TM bundle\n(orange bands = UniProt Transmembrane features)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
